rationale: The importer update planner now exposes deterministic retained/moved/inserted/removed work counts, typed dynamic slot classification, additive benchmark counters, and a fresh authored-plugin fixture with Chromium and Skia receipts. These are Pulp-owned compatibility and observability changes over the existing Skia/Dawn path; the Chromium, packaging, and design-import families are watch-only and no authority moves to or from Vellum.
